entries.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. The user approves this exact beautiful adult woman and asks to keep the picture almost exactly the same, replacing the small pistol with an SKS rifle.
PRESERVE her exact face, eyes, expression, skin, high black ponytail, delicate eyewear, jewelry, revealing black satin halter dress, exposed neckline and thigh, black long gloves, body proportions, leg pose, Art Deco balcony architecture, night train background, golden lighting, palette, framing and the 1024x1536 size. Do not redesign the woman, move her head or change her attractiveness. Do not cover the face or neckline.
Change ONLY the firearm and the minimal hand/forearm placement necessary for a natural hold. Remove the small pistol completely and replace it with ONE unmistakable SKS semi-automatic carbine. Recognizable SKS silhouette: conventional continuous full rifle stock with a traditional wrist grip (NOT a separate AR pistol grip), a short integral magazine under the receiver (NOT an AK long curved magazine), long slender barrel, elevated front sight and characteristic gas-tube profile. NO sniper scope, no AR-15 silhouette, no pump shotgun. The rifle is a luxury fantasy SKS skin: cohesive polished obsidian/black pearl body and elegant champagne-gold metal trim from stock through receiver to fore-end, a subtle small violet moonstone core and fine consistent inlay. It must look like a finished premium fantasy game weapon, not plain wooden military surplus, not a dragon monster.
Place the rifle across her LOWER WAIST at a shallow diagonal, long barrel pointing LEFT, wooden-stock silhouette and both barrel and buttstock entirely readable within the canvas. Use the woman's same leaning body pose. Her right gloved hand naturally wraps around the traditional SKS stock wrist behind the trigger area; her left gloved hand moves only as much as needed from the nearby ledge to support the fore-end or rifle body. Two anatomically convincing hands with straight natural wrist transitions, five fingers each, no hand intersecting the magazine or rifle. The heavier rifle is supported by BOTH hands; do not repeat the awkward one-handed floating gun grip. Rifle must not cover face, bust neckline or most of her torso. Everything beyond this necessary weapon and two-hand contact adjustment stays visually as close to the original as possible.
One 1024x1536 RGB PNG, no extra gun, no text, no logo, no frame, no comparison panels.
